name: Datadog
summary: Metrics, logs, events, monitors, dashboards, hosts, incidents and SLOs from your Datadog organization.

site.description: Your Datadog site, the host your app runs on without 'app.': datadoghq.eu for app.datadoghq.eu. A key only works on the site it was created on.

api_key.description: a Datadog API key (Organization Settings > API Keys)

app_key.description: a Datadog application key (Organization Settings > Application Keys); reads act with its owner's permissions

notes: Every read needs both keys: the API key identifies the organization, the application key the user whose permissions apply. A scoped application key without the endpoint's permission answers 403.
Time units differ by API: v1 metric queries take epoch SECONDS and answer in epoch MILLISECONDS; v2 logs and events take date math ('now-15m') or millisecond timestamps.
Pagination differs by API: v2 endpoints return meta.page.after (or links.next) as a cursor to send back as page[cursor]; v1 endpoints page by number.
Datadog also accepts 'Authorization: Bearer' personal or service access tokens; this entry uses the API and application key pair, which every endpoint accepts.

endpoints.name: Check that the API key is valid
endpoints.summary: Answers {"valid": true} for a working API key. Needs only the API key, so it cannot tell whether the application key works.

endpoints.name: Query a metric's timeseries points
endpoints.summary: Run a metric query such as avg:system.cpu.user{env:prod} by {host} over a time window and get the series back.
notes: Points come back as [epoch_milliseconds, value] pairs in series[].pointlist, at a resolution Datadog picks from the window length.
Needs the timeseries_query permission on the application key.

endpoints.name: List metrics that reported since a time
endpoints.summary: The names of every metric actively reporting since 'from', optionally for one host or tag filter.

from.description: Epoch SECONDS; metrics that reported since then are listed.

tag_filter.description: Only metrics with these tags, e.g. env:prod AND service:web.

endpoints.name: Search logs
endpoints.summary: Logs matching a log search query in a time window, newest or oldest first, one page at a time.

filter.description: {query, from, to, indexes, storage_tier}. query uses log search syntax (default '*'); from/to take date math or epoch ms (default now-15m..now); indexes defaults to ['*']; storage_tier is indexes, online-archives or flex.

page.description: {limit, cursor}. limit defaults to 10; cursor is meta.page.after from the previous answer.

sort.description: Oldest first, or newest first with '-'.

notes: A read over POST: the search is in the body.
Needs the logs_read_data permission. Logs outside your retention window are not searchable.

endpoints.name: List events
endpoints.summary: Events (deploys, alerts, config changes) matching a query in a time window.

from.description: Window start: date math or epoch ms.

to.description: Window end: date math or epoch ms.

endpoints.name: Search monitors
endpoints.summary: Monitors matching attributes such as type:metric status:alert, with counts per status.

sort.description: 'field,direction': name, status or tags; asc or desc.

endpoints.name: List monitors
endpoints.summary: Every monitor's full definition, filtered by name or tags.

monitor_tags.description: Comma-separated tags on the monitor itself, e.g. service:web.

group_states.description: Comma-separated group states to include: all, alert, warn, no data.

page.description: Page number, from 0; paging starts only when page is set.

endpoints.name: Get one monitor
endpoints.summary: One monitor's definition and current state by id.

group_states.description: Comma-separated group states to include: all, alert, warn, no data.

endpoints.name: List dashboards
endpoints.summary: Every dashboard's id, title, author and URL.

endpoints.name: Get one dashboard
endpoints.summary: A dashboard's full definition: widgets, queries, template variables.

dashboard_id.description: The id in the dashboard's URL, e.g. abc-def-ghi.

endpoints.name: List hosts
endpoints.summary: Hosts reporting to Datadog, with their apps, tags, mute state and last report time.

filter.description: Hosts whose name, alias or tag matches, e.g. env:prod.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by, e.g. cpu, iowait, apps.

from.description: Only hosts that reported since this epoch SECOND.

endpoints.name: List incidents
endpoints.summary: Incidents in your organization, newest first.

include.description: Related objects to include: users, attachments.

notes: Needs the incident_read permission. Datadog marks parts of the incidents API as preview.

endpoints.name: List service level objectives
endpoints.summary: SLO definitions, filtered by ids, name, tags or the metrics they use.

metrics_query.description: SLOs that use this metric query.
